name: Fluxer
description: Free and open source chat and voice for friends, groups and communities.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (postgres/), uploaded files (seaweedfs/), search (meilisearch/), the message bus (nats/), Valkey (valkey/) and the secret keys (state/). Back up the whole folder: the keys in state/secrets.env can't be changed once Fluxer has data.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Fluxer web app, API, websocket, media and admin panel, published on host as 6692

ports.name: Port 6693
ports.description: Voice and video (LiveKit) over TCP, published on host as 6693. Must stay 6693.

ports.name: Port 6694
ports.description: Voice and video (LiveKit) over UDP, published on host as 6694. Must stay 6694.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6692. Fluxer only works at this one address. For voice, video, passkeys and notifications use HTTPS: put Fluxer behind a reverse proxy with your own domain (pointed at port 6692) and set this to it, like https://chat.example.com.
